_note: Text shown above each collection in the Gallery view. Keys are collection names from collections.json; '_all_bw' and '_all_color' are shown when 'All' is selected. Edit freely, then run: python3 tools/build-manifest.py
_all_bw: 35mm film, mostly black and white. Places, people and the quiet space around them, picked from the rolls that came back right.
_all_color: Colour film, kept for the frames where the colour was the point.
Mountains: Stone roofs, a bucket hanging from a beam, a chairlift parked between two houses. Lower down the valley the orchards sit under nets and the vineyards are still only poles. Not much happens up here, and the pictures let it stay that way.
Riviera: The coast out of season: a flat grey sea, a kiosk selling ice cream to nobody, washing hung out between two roofs. Without the summer crowd the Riviera is quieter and a little more honest.
Surf trip: A few days on a long, empty beach with friends. Most of these are pictures of waiting: for the tide, for a set, for someone to walk back out of the water. The surfing is almost the least of it; the faces are what stayed.
The Rock: A small place with a lot of sky. Seen from the top it is an airstrip, a football pitch and a bay curving away; down on the ground it is lighthouses, a red phone box and a tunnel with bicycles riding towards the light.
Summer house: White walls, steps down to the sea, a closed parasol standing there like a person. Then the people themselves: a towel turban, a face caught in a window, someone floating with their arms open. Summer at its slowest, when the only plan is the water.
Facades: Buildings seen close enough that they stop being buildings: scales of metal, folded shadows, a grid with one small square window. Now and then a person walks through, mostly for scale, mostly in shadow. Look up long enough and everything turns into pattern.
City: Stairwells, frosted glass, a car parked on cobbles seen from a window above. People show up blurred behind glass, never quite in focus, which is how you see most strangers in a city. And a wall asking which news you want first.
Travels: Colour, for once. A lamp like a balloon against a grey sky, a tiled minaret against a very blue one, a photo booth on a seaside square. Things that already looked slightly unreal on the day.
